How to read the battlefield

The field axis is the BTC/USD price. On the left is the Greek camp (bulls, buyers), on the right the Mongol horde (bears, sellers). Field markers are $50 steps from the round's starting price.

Front line

  • Price rises — the Greeks push the Mongols right; price falls — the Mongols push left.
  • Break through the outer line (±$300) and the round is won; the armies regroup around the new price.
  • Green and red glow at the front shows order book liquidity near the price.

Troops

  • Infantry (hoplites / Mongol warriors) — trade flow: the side buying or selling more aggressively fields more fighters who strike more often and land more hits. Each warrior finds his own enemy and fights him.
  • Cavalry — order book depth on its side: riders charge into enemy infantry again and again. More Mongol horse archers appear as volatility rises.
  • Archers — shoot faster as volatility rises.
  • Melee — warriors duel one-on-one: a shield can block a blow, two wounds bring a man down. The fallen are replaced from the rear ranks.
  • King Leonidas / Genghis Khan — appear when a large buy / sell wall shows up in the order book, and leave when it disappears.

Big events

  • Trade over $100K — a volley of javelins (buy) or arrows (sell). Over $1M — a cavalry sortie as well.
  • Long liquidations hit the Greeks, short liquidations hit the Mongols: under $50K — arrows, $50K+ — mounted raid, $150K+ — cavalry charge, $500K+ — a rain of fire arrows.

Sound

The Sound button turns on the battle audio: recorded sword clashes, hits on armor and shields, war drums and battle ambience, plus whistling arrows, galloping cavalry and horns. A musical theme plays when sound is enabled and when a round is won. The hotter the market, the louder the battle and the drums.

Want more recordings? Click «📁 Sounds» or drop audio files onto the page. Files are sorted by name: sword/clash — swords, shield — shields, hit/stab — hits, gallop/hoof — hooves, scream/death — screams, shout/battle cry — war cries, arrow — arrows. Free (CC0) packs: 20 Sword Sound Effects, Battle Sound Effects, Medieval weapon impacts.

Data

Order books and trades: Binance (BTCUSDT), Coinbase (BTC-USD), Kraken (BTC/USD). Liquidations: Binance and Bybit futures. If the exchanges are unreachable, a simulation starts — shown in the source selector.
